messages:
Maya R: Heads up — ingesting new open model "sapphire-v1" into the catalog. Need owners, licensing signoff, perf profile, and staging canary dates. Quick check: primary owner? :eyes:

Priya S: I can be primary owner for curation/perf. I'll run the perf suite. Can someone confirm license type/clauses?

liz-legal: quick note — repo lists Apache-2.0 + small dataset with CC-BY snippets. Legal: Apache is OK, must include model card + attributions. Ping me if any data-use flags.

Jon K: perf note: on A10G baseline with fp16, seq=2048, batch=4 we hit OOM. We should test smaller batch or int8. I left a failing log: ```ERR: OOM at token 1024, batch=4, mem=24GB```

Priya S: thanks. I'll try int8 quant and a 1024 default seq. test command: ```scripts/run_perf.sh --model sapphire-v1 --bs 8 --seq 1024 --dtype int8```

Ethan L: infra: A10G expected but for dedicated we need ~32GB effective for seq2048. If quant helps we can fit in 16GB. For canary, prefer starting with 512 seq. Also need pre-warm KV cache config.

infra-bot: Canary created — canary id canary-20260312-sapphire. Scheduled window: 2026-03-12 02:00-06:00 UTC. Assigned pool: staging-gpu-pool-3.

Jon K: CR needed on runtime kernel selector change for sapphire quant branch. @Maya R can you assign? PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/487

Maya R: assigning CR to Jon & Priya for perf/accuracy sweep. Actions: Priya run perf + accuracy sweep (seq 512/1024, int8/fp16), Jon review runtime PR, Liz finalize model card + license note, Ethan confirm canary infra and KV pre-warm. Target: canary 2026-03-12. Any blockers?

Priya S: one more blocker — tokenizer variant (byte-level vs sentencepiece) needs check. Will add tokenizer artifact to intake bundle.

liz-legal: also add short provenance field in model card with dataset links.

Maya R: great — owners listed. I'll update the intake ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MLC-742. Closing thread, ping me in-thread if anything slips.
